text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 5) 2024.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 28 Oktober 2024 hingga 3 November 2024.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing biri-biri bertulang import

2. Tomato

3. Kacang dal (Australia)

Dibuat 16 Oktober 2024

[KPDN(PGK)(S)26/0.5001/1 Jld.12; PN(PU2)188/JLD.14]

DATUK ARMIZAN BIN MOHD ALI

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Kos Sara Hidup

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 5) ORDER 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 5) Order 2024.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles

for the period from 28 October 2024 to 3 November 2024.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported bone-in mutton

2. Tomato

3. Dhal (Australia)

Made 16 October 2024

[KPDN(PGK)(S)26/0.5001/1 Jld.12; PN(PU2)188/JLD.14]

DATUK ARMIZAN BIN MOHD ALI

Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living
